jobs.occupation: 100% Remote Customer Success Manager – Hotel SaaS Platform (Hospitality Industry, DE & EN) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Company OverviewHotel Res Bot is a fast-growing company helping hotels and travel agencies automate their inbound communications using self-trained AI.Our platform is designed specifically for reservation and group sales teams, helping them manage and respond to high volumes of inbound email communication more efficiently and consistently.We integrate with hotel systems such as PMS and booking engines, but our core focus is improving how hotel teams handle guest and group requests via email in their daily operations.We are a small, international team working in a trust-based, remote-first environment where ownership, clarity, and direct communication matter more than hierarchy.Job SummaryThis is a client success role focused on helping hotel reservation and group sales teams adopt new ways of working, integrate our system into their daily operations, and build long-term, trusted relationships.You will act as the main point of contact for your clients and ensure the system becomes part of their day-to-day workflow, particularly in how they manage and respond to inbound emails, enquiries, and group requests.The role is about driving real usage and long-term value in operational environments — not sales and not technical implementation.You should understand how hotels operate, especially reservation or sales departments, and be comfortable working with hotel systems and communication workflows.Attitude & CultureSince this is a fully remote position within a small but close-knit international team, we place strong importance on finding someone who is comfortable working independently, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of their responsibilities.We work in a trust-based, non-micromanaged environment. You have flexibility in how and when you work, and in return we expect reliability, accountability, and good judgement in managing your clients and responsibilities.Support and collaboration are always available when needed, but this role is best suited to someone who is proactive, organised, and comfortable operating with a high level of autonomy.We also place strong value on a healthy team and error culture. We focus on learning and improving together rather than assigning blame. Open, respectful communication is essential to us — disagreement is welcome, but personal attacks are not. Maintaining a constructive and collaborative environment is especially important in a fully remote company.Your ImpactClient Success & Adoption- Own relationships with hotel reservation and group sales teams- Support teams in integrating the system into daily email-based workflows- Ensure clients are actively using the platform in real operational settings- Conduct regular online check-ins and occasional onsite visits (day trips)- Identify gaps in adoption and proactively improve usage and engagementThe Voice of the Customer- Act as the main bridge between hotel operations and our internal team- Translate real operational challenges into structured, actionable feedback- Ensure the system reflects how hotels actually manage guest and group communication in practice- Help improve workflows, messaging, and configurations based on real-world usageRelationship Ownership- Build and maintain long-term, trusted relationships with hotel teams- Monitor usage, engagement, and operational success over time- Ensure clients consistently gain value from improved communication workflows- Maintain accurate and structured records of client interactions and activityInternal Collaboration- Work closely with support, product, and technical teams- Support smooth handovers from onboarding and implementation- Contribute to improving internal processes based on real client feedbackWho You AreThe Hotel Operator- 2–3 years experience in: - hotel reservations department, OR- group sales department, OR- front office with strong email handling responsibility- Strong understanding of how hotel reservation and group email workflows operate in practiceThe Communicator- Fluent in German (C1 / business level – required)- Fluent in English (required)- Spanish is a plus, but not required- Able to communicate clearly with both operational teams (e.g. reservations, group sales) and senior hotel or HQ management, adapting the message to the audience while keeping clarity and structure- Comfortable proactively engaging with clients via email, phone, or online calls when needed to support adoption and ensure effective daily use of the system- Able to help align day-to-day usage with longer-term operational goals and ensure the system is delivering value across both operational and management levelsTech-Aware (but not technical)- Understanding of hotel systems such as: - PMS- Booking engines- Channel managers (basic understanding)- Comfortable learning and working with digital tools used for client management and reporting- No coding required, but confident working with structured systems and workflowsProject Management (Nice to Have)- Previous experience in project coordination or project management, or relevant training/certification, is a plus- Comfortable coordinating tasks, tracking progress, and following up with different stakeholders to keep activities on schedule- Able to manage multiple client priorities while maintaining clear communication and structured documentationOwnership Mindset- Works independently and takes responsibility for outcomes- Structured, reliable, and proactive- Identifies issues early and acts before escalation is neededGrowth & DevelopmentThis role offers clear long-term development opportunities into:- Senior Customer Success roles- Implementation / Operations Lead roles- Product-facing or solution-focused positions- Closer collaboration with product and operational strategyWe actively support learning, ownership, and internal progression.Benefits- 100% remote work environment- Flexible working hours- Flat hierarchy and direct access to decision-makers- Supportive international team culture- Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing company- Company-provided equipment (Laptop + screen + keyboard + mouse)How to ApplyPlease send your CV and a short cover letter explaining:- Your experience in hotel reservations or group sales- Your experience handling high volumes of guest or group emails- Why you are interested in hotel communication automation and operational improvement- Your language skills and eligibility to work in Spain or PortugalPlease send applications to:career@hotelresbot.comEqual Opportunity StatementHotel Res Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment for all employees.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 100%

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Manager (d/f/m) R&D Operational Excellence & Process Improvement (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: In this role, you will drive the efficiency of the global Stage-Gate process for product development across LIXIL's brands and regions. You are the operational engine behind our R&D delivery: ensuring clear work packages, disciplined gate transitions, and practical governance that project teams can easily adopt. As the primary subject matter expert, you will serve as the trusted advisor for project managers and gatekeepers on all process inquiries.The role works through influence across a matrixed, multi-cultural organisation and is a service to colleagues rather than an audit function. R&D is in active transformation on tooling and data quality, so ambiguity and shifting priorities are part of the job.Your Responsibilities:- Drive continuous optimisation of the global Stage-Gate Work Packages, ensuring deliverables are lean, consistent and harmonised across brands and regions.- Maintain and enforce the global R&D governance framework: processes, tools, RASCI models, cadence structures and compliance checkpoints.- Safeguard gate readiness, documentation integrity and audit readiness across all gate transitions.- Define, track and report R&D KPIs covering gate discipline, cycle time and pipeline health.- Develop and maintain digitalized templates, blueprints, work instructions and process documentation that simplify execution for project managers.- Coordinate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment, so local delivery conforms to global R&D standards.- Ensure Stage-Gate documentation and gate data are captured consistently and kept current in the governing systems, and represent process requirements towards the system owners.- Build and maintain the R&D Knowledge Hub as the single, topic-structured source for process documentation, templates and training material, curated as an ongoing exercise.- Ensure data continuity between Stage-Gate governance and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), acting as the business-side representative to translate process requirements into system specifications with the Global PLM team.Your Profile:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Industrial Management or comparable.- 7 to 10 years in process management, R&D project management or operational excellence, gained across more than one industry, ideally in product development or manufacturing.- Proven implementation of Stage-Gate or comparable phase-gate models- Working understanding of project and portfolio management systems used in an R&D environment (e.g. Planisware Orchestra, SAP) and good data literacy for KPI definition and process analysis.- Interest in how AI, automation and digital tools can simplify product development processes.- Solid understanding of PLM, ERP, and engineering change management systems (e.g., SAP, Planisware Orchestra), with the ability to align process governance with system architecture.- Demonstrated comfort, curiosity and respect across cultures and working styles is a core requirement.- Gives and receives feedback constructively.- Lean, Six Sigma or comparable optimisation approaches an advantage.- Strong moderation and stakeholder skills, able to steer cross-regional teams without direct reporting lines. Able to translate between technical detail and business framing.- Business-fluent English required, German an advantage.Our offer:- A salary package that ties directly to your work experience and responsibilities- Comprehensive health management, including an on-site fitness room, local and digital health services, Health Cashback, and Hansefit membership- Diversity & Inclusion: We offer equal opportunities for all individuals and support your personal development- Access to a wide range of employee benefits, such as discounts on travel, fashion, media, mobile phones, and more- A highly motivated, appreciative, and international team that inspires you and offers opportunities to learn and grow- A modern company restaurant to ensure your well-being during the dayInterested?Then we are looking forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d)  of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Museum of Natural History in Görlitz, ideally as of April 1, 2027:Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d) of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track)(full time / part time options available)Location: GörlitzEmployment scope: full time / part time options are availableType of contract: initially limited to three years;the type of time limitation depends on individual profile and legal framework (maximum 3+3 years). A permanent employment is planned after a positive evaluationRemuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The renowned Senckenberg Museum of Natural History, located in the medieval town of Görlitz, combines research at an international level with extensive collections and an engaging museum programme. The surrounding Upper Lusatia region offers a large variety of opportunities for experiencing nature.Senckenberg is committed to study the causes and effects of biodiversity loss in the Anthropocene. As part of our strategic development, we launched an ambitious long-term research effort in “Anthropocene Biodiversity Loss” encompassing the modules “Collectomics”, “Biodiversity Genomics”, and “Solution Labs”. Objectives include the transformation of natural history collections into the digital era, studying biodiversity from the genome to the ecosystem levels and offering exploratory spaces for science and society to develop common solutions to Anthropocene challenges.For the Görlitz vertebrate collection, which comprises approximately 70,000 specimens (preserved using dry, cryogenic, and liquid preservation methods, with the focus on mammals; birds make up a smaller proportion, while other vertebrate groups represent only a small fraction), we are seeking an internationally recognized scientist with a solid track record in mammal research, possibly supplemented by work on another vertebrate groups.Potential research topics may include various aspects such as mammalian diversity, functional morphology, phylogeny, or biological interactions. Curation and collection-based research should play a significant role in the applicant’s research approach. The selected candidate should be open to research collaborations with SGN colleaguesYour tasks- Scientific curation and development of the vertebrate collection and the associated resources as an important international research infrastructure through international networking, growth, and improved accessibility.- Develop a visible portfolio of collection-based research with basic and applied aspects in the broad field of mammalogy and possibly other vertebrate groups by using a range of established and innovative methods and approaches.- Taking responsibility for the relocation of the collection items, including the infrastructure of the Mammalogy/Vertebrate Section, to the new campus at Bahnhofstraße 30 at Görlitz.- Secure external research funds.- Publish results of your research in international scientific outlets.- Establish collaborations with ongoing projects, regional and national (region (e.g., long-term projects on wolf, lynx) and international (e.g., Africa, Mongolia), including with other sections and departments in Görlitz and further Senckenberg institutes.- Communicate with external stakeholders such as scientific associations, conservation agencies, local and regional authorities, as well as citizen scientists.- Participate in teaching in the MSc level programmes of International Institute Zittau/ Dresden University of Technology.Your profile- Doctoral degree in biology/zoology or a related field- Expert knowledge of mammals, including native species (the biogeographic focus of the mammal collection is currently the Palearctic), additional expertise in other vertebrate groups- Proactive willingness to implement innovative research approaches, such as in the field of genomics, morphometrics, AI, imaging, 3D methods, pollutant analysis in a collection context- Ability to identify attractive research questions and make use of synergies through collaborations- Excellent academic track record adequate to your career stage- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding and project management- Experience in supervising staff (doctoral candidates, BSc., MSc., students, technical staff), ability to work in a team- Very good command of German (B2)- Fluency in English, both spoken and written- Class B driving licence (international driving licence)- Willingness to travel on occasion to the extent possible considering your personal circumstancesDesirable skills- Knowledge in molecular, biochemical or biophysical techniques in taxonomy and ecology- Knowledge in research data management and databases- Experience in curation and management of zoological collections, and in museum workWe offer- Access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- An attractive job within the inspiring and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution with excellent infrastructures and collaborations opportunities, e. g. in morphology, genomics, evolutionary biology, (paleo-)ecology- A working place in completely new building with dissection and other laboratories, collection rooms, in the historic town of Görlitz with rapidly developing local research community (DZA, CASUS, IHI/TUD, HiLusatia), yet situated very close to nature with high mammal diversity and opportunities for field work- Opportunities to participate in teaching and outreach activities, e.g., in our museum and with collaborating universities- Opportunities for establishing an independent academic working group and acquiring further academic qualifications- Flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability, they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) as a single PDF file by November 10, 2026.https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.deContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt a.M.For specific questions about this role please contact Prof. Dr. Hjalmar S. Kühl.E-Mail hjalmar.kuehl@senckenberg.de

jobs.description: Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.What you can expect:- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained.
